name: Koibito wa Kouan Keiji
source:
You've just entered a police academy with high hopes for your future. It's just happened that you'd need not only study here, but also be an aide for one of the handsome instructors and work on some real cases with him. 

As there is only two women in this academy there is no way you won't fall in love with somebody around you.
translation:
你刚刚进入警察学院，对自己的未来充满希望。正好你不仅要在这里学习，还要成为一位帅气导师的助手，和他一起做一些真实的案例。

由于这所学院只有两名女性，所以你不可能不爱上周围的人。
